review_description: Neither of your two suggestions were prepared to undertake a site inspection.We live in metro Bendigo, so it wouldn't be that hard.I would not proceed with solar, if I did not get a firm and fixed installation quotation.Thank you for your website and the information it contains.Very useful.

Byers were excellent in customer service, professional and very efficient staff. The quote was the best we could find in our area. The tradesmen were polite, on time and completed the task to a very high standard.
